title: CIA's Charles Cabell, the Dallas motorcade route and Project Blue Book

tellings.quote: cabel you know CIA off officer cabel uh had seen Blue Book and he said you know this is a super shoddy operation and this is written up in Edward J rupal's book

plain: A CIA officer named Charles Cabell looked at Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and called it a "super shoddy operation", according to Michels. Michels says this is written up in Edward J. Ruppelt's book The Report on Unidentified Flying Objects, published in 1956. He tells it in an episode about a man he links to many American conspiracies, where the same Cabell is also tied to the Dallas motorcade route, and he uses it to show that a senior intelligence figure was paying close attention to how the UFO question was handled.
